account.description: Named CLI account. Empty uses the default. Ignored with Automatic.
account.label: Account label

color_by_usage.description: Color the reading by usage. Off uses the bar color.
color_by_usage.label: Color by usage

extras.description: Show reset time or usage pace against elapsed time.
extras.label: Extra information

glyph_position.description: Place the icon before or after the reading.
glyph_position.label: Icon position

provider_limit.description: Automatic only. Order: severity, then usage. +N counts the rest.
provider_limit.label: Provider limit

refresh_minutes.description: Fetch usage at this interval. Countdowns update between reads.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)

show_glyph.description: Show the provider icon beside the reading.
show_glyph.label: Show icon

show_name.description: Show provider or model names beside their readings.
show_name.label: Show names

show_value.description: Show the reported percentage or amount.
show_value.label: Show value

vendor.description: Automatic ranks by severity, then usage.
vendor.label: Provider

visualization.description: Show a quota bar beside the reading.
visualization.label: Visualization

usage_display.label: Show quota as
usage_display.description: Used or remaining quota. Colors and priority follow usage.

quota_window.label: Quota window
quota_window.description: Exhausted windows take priority. No percentage if unavailable.

auto_providers.label: Automatic filter
auto_providers.description: Provider IDs or provider@account. Empty includes all. Automatic only.

error.no_data_hint: ai-usagebar ran but reported no usage. Check the providers in `~/.config/ai-usagebar/config.toml`.
error.not_installed_hint: The CLI is not on PATH. Install it, then try again.
error.spawn_failed_hint: The process never started. Try again in a moment.
error.timed_out_hint: The read took too long. A provider may be answering slowly.

ui.plan_changed: The plan changed; readings taken under the previous one were dropped.
ui.title: AI Usage
ui.setup_hint: Check reported failures and local provider configuration.
ui.setup_notifications: The CLI manages alerts. To turn them off, set enabled = false under [notifications] in its config.toml.
ui.diagnostics_login: Check this account's credentials and access with the provider, then refresh usage.
ui.diagnostics_local_app: If Antigravity is closed, open it so its local server can run, then refresh usage. No API key is required.
ui.diagnostics_configure: Configure this provider's credentials for ai-usagebar, then refresh status and usage.
ui.diagnostics_update_cli: Update ai-usagebar, then refresh usage to retry reading this report.
ui.diagnostics_retry: Wait a moment, then refresh usage.
ui.diagnostics_check_cli: Check this provider and account in ai-usagebar for more details, then refresh usage.
ui.diagnostics_old_usage: The displayed usage is an old reading.
ui.diagnostics_no_problems: No problems found in the available reports. Credential presence does not confirm a working connection.
ui.diagnostics_recheck: Refresh usage to check whether this earlier problem persists.
